about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

caWhole restores the full DFHCOMMAREA area from the EIBCALEN-narrowed copy at the end of a task. COTRN02C reads DFHCOMMAREA only as DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) (COTRN02C.cbl line 119, before anything here runs), and the RETURN / XCTL COMMAREA is built from CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, so the restored area's contents (a one-byte shift of them included) are not observable for a terminal task

without initialState's copy of DFHCOMMAREA's image the area keeps what the last task left; COTRN02C reads only DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN), which the task writes from the caller's COMMAREA first, and for a terminal task the area's final contents are not observable
ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS is a VALUE-initialised item of the CVACT01Y copybook; COTRN02C never reads or writes it (its only ACCT names are WS-ACCT-ID-N and XREF-ACCT-ID), so the initial value cannot show
COTRN02C has no HANDLE CONDITION / HANDLE AID / HANDLE ABEND (and no IGNORE CONDITION), so the handlers map is never filled and clearing it changes nothing
COTRN02C reads only EIBAID and EIBCALEN of the EIB (COTRN02C.cbl); EIBDATE is never read, so its value cannot show

the narrowing of DFHCOMMAREA to EIBCALEN bytes only matters to a reference past EIBCALEN, and COTRN02C reads DFHCOMMAREA only as DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) (COTRN02C.cbl line 119); with the narrowing applied or not, the bytes read are the same, and the typed COMMAREA the program returns comes from CARDDEMO-COMMAREA
at calen == the area's length the narrowing copies the area to a same-length array, which changes no byte; for every other calen the comparison agrees

the finally block's caWhole(caWhole) only restores the full area after an abend or a refusal; on every RETURN / XCTL path caBack's own caWhole(whole) has already restored it, and after an abend the task ends with no COMMAREA, so the area is not observable

the region name is used when a program LINKs to COTRN02C; no CardDemo program LINKs COTRN02C (it is reached by terminal transaction CT02 and XCTL only), so task.linkArea() is null and this is never taken

the scan over outer PERFORMs runs only after a paragraph that is not its range's last returns; every PERFORM in COTRN02C names one paragraph (from == thru) except runTask's perform(0, 17), and MAIN-PARA (0) always ends in RETURN / XCTL, so the scan never iterates

the scan over outer PERFORMs runs only after a paragraph that is not its range's last returns; every PERFORM in COTRN02C names one paragraph (from == thru) except runTask's perform(0, 17), and MAIN-PARA (0) always ends in RETURN / XCTL, so the test is never evaluated

the final RETURN TRANSID(CT02) re-enters COTRN02C itself, and the next task is the only reader of the COMMAREA length (its EIBCALEN). COTRN02C uses EIBCALEN twice: IF EIBCALEN = 0 (line 115), false for the length either way; and MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) TO CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (line 119), whose target CARDDEMO-COMMAREA is 218 bytes, so the one extra byte of the 219-byte mutant is truncated. DFHCOMMAREA is read nowhere else. Proposed for owner review, like the COADM01C line-952 verdict

survivors.reason: the COMPUTE runs only after the amount passed its format check (sign, 8 digits, '.', 2 digits: COTRN02C.cbl lines 340-343), so |value| < 10^8 and fits S9(9)V99 (11 digits) with room to spare: one more digit of width changes no stored value

RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN is performed only after CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM is set: to COSGN00C (EIBCALEN = 0, line 116), to COMEN01C, or to CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM when that is not blank (PF3, lines 137-141), so the IF is false for either operator; with OR vs AND the branch is never taken
`to` is what condition() returns, and with no HANDLE CONDITION / ABEND in COTRN02C and only EOC ignored by default (RECEIVE only), condition() throws for any SEND MAP failure and never returns

COTRN02C never references EIBRESP or EIBRESP2 (its commands use RESP(WS-RESP-CD) / RESP2(WS-REAS-CD); the only EIB fields it reads are EIBAID and EIBCALEN), so the store's value or absence cannot show

the next-paragraph index READPREV-TRANSACT-FILE returns is read only when the paragraph is not its range's last, and every PERFORM of it names that paragraph alone (from == thru), so the index is dropped
`to` is what condition() returns, and with no HANDLE CONDITION / ABEND in COTRN02C and only EOC ignored by default (RECEIVE only), condition() throws for any ENDBR failure and never returns
